workItem.goal: Let callers render a status badge with an optional neutral, positive, warning, or critical tone; expose the effective tone in markup, default omission to neutral, and preserve the badge's status and label behavior without requiring feature-view changes.

outlines.changes: Extend the existing shared StatusBadge surface compatibly: add an optional closed tone prop, normalize omission to neutral at render time, and emit the effective value as data-tone beside data-status. Keep the current status-derived default wording and explicit-label behavior untouched. Add focused unit coverage and owned Cucumber step definitions for both pending scenarios; the catalog and review feature views remain unchanged because the prop is optional.

decomposition.rationale: The leaf owner contains the component and its tests, and the compatible implementation plus scenario bindings are small enough for one coherent iteration.

reuse.role: Retain the existing status-derived default labels, explicit-label override, and independent data-status markup while adding tone.

outlines.changes: StatusBadgeProps now accepts an optional closed neutral | positive | warning | critical tone, and StatusBadge defaults omission to neutral and emits the effective value as data-tone beside the unchanged data-status. Existing status-derived wording and explicit-label behavior remain intact, existing feature views require no edits, and focused unit tests plus owned Cucumber bindings cover supplied and omitted tones.

decomposition.rationale: The component change, regression coverage, and scenario bindings were completed coherently in the shared-ui leaf owner in one accepted iteration.

reuse.role: The tone extension retains the existing status-derived default labels, explicit-label override, and independent data-status markup.

iterations.goal: Implement optional status-badge tones and bind both tone acceptance scenarios without changing existing feature views or badge wording behavior.
iterations.approach: In status-badge.tsx, add an optional tone property whose type is the closed union neutral | positive | warning | critical, default it to neutral while destructuring/rendering, and emit the effective value as data-tone on the existing span beside data-status. Do not add domain knowledge, styling, or require caller changes; preserve defaultLabels and label override semantics. Extend the owned unit tests with provided-tone and omitted-tone assertions, and add Cucumber step definitions under src/tests/steps that render StatusBadge to static markup and bind both supplied scenarios.

scope.rationale: The component, exposed props, unit suite, feature scenarios, and new step definitions all belong to the shared-ui leaf module. Existing feature consumers and the neutral status vocabulary need only be read to confirm compatibility and must not be edited.

iterations.completionEvidence: The shared-ui tests and type check pass; StatusBadge accepts only the four specified optional tone literals, rendered markup always includes the supplied tone or neutral when omitted, data-status and existing label/default wording assertions still pass, and quick-mode Cucumber execution passes both owned scenarios through step definitions in src/tests/steps.

findings: The scenario harness discovers TypeScript step definitions with a .ts extension, so the bindings use React.createElement rather than JSX.
